label: LATE: results date > 7 days later than the same quarter last year
EARLY: results date > 7 days earlier than last year
NOTICE_SHORT: intimation lead time >= 7 days shorter than the stock's habit
NOTICE_LONG: lead time >= 7 days longer than habit
NOTICE_MIN: lead time <= 7 days (near the legal minimum)
NEWS_HI: 30-day news flow >= 1.5x the stock's norm
PRESS: press release(s) in the 30 days before the cutoff
ORDER: order win(s) in the 30 days before
ACQ: acquisition announcement(s) in the 30 days before
NOCALL: no earnings call / analyst meet announced in the 21 days before
BIZ_UP: business update(s) in 45 days, market reaction > 0
PROM_BUY: promoter acquisition (SAST Reg 29) in the 90 days before
PROM_SELL: promoter sale in the 90 days before
HOLD_BUY: large non-promoter holder buying in 90 days
HOLD_SELL: large non-promoter holder selling in 90 days
